summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on 12 May 2026. The meeting covered routine items: consideration of annual management report, approval of consolidated financial statements and annual accounts, allocation of results and approval of a US$0.89 per share dividend (including an interim dividend), discharge of board members, and board elections. No special situation or corporate event is present. This is a standard shareholder meeting disclosure.
